description: The effective certificates and TLS settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

key_type.description: Key type of new certificates (env ACME_KEY_TYPE)

key_size.description: Curve (ecdsa) or key size (rsa) of new certificates (env ACME_KEY_SIZE)

profile.description: ACME profile of new certificates, empty = none; must be offered by the ACME server (env ACME_PROFILE)

must_staple.description: Request certificates with the OCSP must-staple extension, forces OCSP stapling on (env ACME_MUST_STAPLE)

server_tls_verify.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the ACME server (env ACME_SERVER_TLS_VERIFY)

renewal_interval.description: Hours between certificate renewal runs (env CERTBOT_RUN_INTERVAL)

ocsp_stapling.description: OCSP stapling for ACME certificates (env ACME_OCSP_STAPLING)

custom_ocsp_stapling.description: OCSP stapling for custom certificates (env CUSTOM_OCSP_STAPLING)

default_certificate_id.description: Certificate of the default host, 0 = built-in (env DEFAULT_CERT_ID)

ech_rotation_interval.description: Hours between ECH key rotations (env ECH_ROTATION_INTERVAL)

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

key_type.description: Name of the variable that locks the key type: ACME_KEY_TYPE, or ACME_KEY_SIZE when it forces the field

key_size.description: Name of the variable that locks the key size: ACME_KEY_SIZE

profile.description: Name of the variable that locks the profile: ACME_PROFILE

must_staple.description: Name of the variable that locks the must staple: ACME_MUST_STAPLE, or ACME_OCSP_STAPLING when it forces the field

server_tls_verify.description: Name of the variable that locks the server tls verify: ACME_SERVER_TLS_VERIFY

renewal_interval.description: Name of the variable that locks the renewal interval: CERTBOT_RUN_INTERVAL

ocsp_stapling.description: Name of the variable that locks the ocsp stapling: ACME_OCSP_STAPLING, or ACME_MUST_STAPLE when it forces the field

custom_ocsp_stapling.description: Name of the variable that locks the custom ocsp stapling: CUSTOM_OCSP_STAPLING

default_certificate_id.description: Name of the variable that locks the default certificate id: DEFAULT_CERT_ID

ech_rotation_interval.description: Name of the variable that locks the ech rotation interval: ECH_ROTATION_INTERVAL

locked_reason.description: Fields locked by the environment variable of another setting (an indirect lock), with the reason: key-size (the key type follows ACME_KEY_SIZE), ocsp-stapling-off (Must-Staple is off because ACME_OCSP_STAPLING turns OCSP stapling off), must-staple (OCSP stapling is required by ACME_MUST_STAPLE), goaccess (GoAccess reads the log files). Fields locked by their own variable are not listed.

key_type.description: Why the key type is locked by another setting's variable: key-size, when only ACME_KEY_SIZE is set

must_staple.description: Why the must staple is locked by another setting's variable: ocsp-stapling-off, when ACME_OCSP_STAPLING turns OCSP stapling off

ocsp_stapling.description: Why the ocsp stapling is locked by another setting's variable: must-staple, when ACME_MUST_STAPLE is on

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

key_type.description: When a change of the key type takes effect: with the next certificate that is requested or renewed

key_size.description: When a change of the key size takes effect: with the next certificate that is requested or renewed

profile.description: When a change of the profile takes effect: with the next certificate that is requested or renewed

must_staple.description: When a change of the must staple takes effect: with the next certificate that is requested or renewed

server_tls_verify.description: When a change of the server tls verify takes effect: with the next certificate that is requested or renewed

renewal_interval.description: When a change of the renewal interval takes effect: on save

ocsp_stapling.description: When a change of the ocsp stapling takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

custom_ocsp_stapling.description: When a change of the custom ocsp stapling takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

default_certificate_id.description: When a change of the default certificate id takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

ech_rotation_interval.description: When a change of the ech rotation interval takes effect: on save

restart_pending.description: Always empty: every certificates and TLS setting applies without a container restart
